message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: .NET Core

on: [push, pull_request]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup .NET Core
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: 8.0.200
        cache: true
        
    - name: Test
      run: |
        cd Tests/UnitTests
        dotnet test
        cd ../../
        
    - name: Build
      run: |
        dotnet build ./OrleansDashboard.sln --configuration Release
  
    - name: Publish
      run: |
        dotnet nuget push **/Release/*.*.nupkg --source 'https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json' -k ${{ secrets.nuget }} --skip-duplicate
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/4.0'
",
  "rationale": "Three evidence-supported optimizations applied: (1) Concurrency with cancel-in-progress implements P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE to cancel superseded runs on the same ref, reducing duplicate work (literature reports 1.9-4.1% VM time reduction). (2) Job-level timeout-minutes: 30 implements P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT to bound runaway jobs; measured experiment shows 26.8% elapsed savings and literature estimates 8-13% VM time reduction. (3) setup-dotnet cache: true enables NuGet package caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE), avoiding repeated dependency downloads; literature reports modest aggregate benefit and experiment shows pip caching pattern. Action versions updated to v4 for maintained support. No permissions weakened, no new secrets or network access added.",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508",
    "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2",
    "pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE",
    "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE",
    "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"
  ]
}
